headline: Collective bargaining training and public comment on collective bargaining negotiations.
summary: The meeting covers collective bargaining and negotiations. It includes a public forum on that topic and a training presentation by Matthew H. Upton, Executive Director of Legal and Policy.
items: Public forum on collective bargaining and negotiations; speakers have up to three minutes and comments must relate to the agenda item
Motion, if no one else wishes to speak, to take comments under advisement, receive and file written documents, and table remaining public comment to the end of the meeting
Collective bargaining presentation by Matthew H. Upton, Executive Director of Legal and Policy, for information and training purposes only
location: Large Conference Room, Manchester SAU District Office, 20 Hecker Street
plain_text:
AGENDA  
 
BOARD OF SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
SPECIAL MEETING – BOARD TRAINING 
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
 
October 28, 2026 6:00 p.m.  
Mayor and all School Board Members Manchester SAU  District Office  
 20 Hecker Street, Large Conference Room  
 
1. Mayor Ruais calls the meeting to order.  
 
2. Mayor Ruais calls for the Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
3. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
PUBLIC FORUM 
 
4. The purpose of the public forum is to give the residents of Manchester the opportunity to 
address the board regarding the item that is on this special agenda this evening, being 
Collective Bargaining/Negotiations.  All people wishing to speak will have up to three (3) 
minutes to do so, and any comments must be directly related to the item on the agenda and 
must be directed to the chair.  Any resident wishing to speak will come forward to the nearest 
microphone, clearly state their name and address when recognized and give their comments.  
 
a. If there is no one else present wishing to speak, a motion is in order to take all 
comments under advisement and further to receive and file any written documentation 
presented and to table the remaining minutes for public comment to the end of the 
meeting for those that have not already spoken. 
 
5.   Collective Bargaining – by Matthew H. Upton, Executive Director of Legal and Policy 
 (Note:  This item is for informational and training purposes only.) 
 
 ADJOURNMENT 
 
6. This being a special meeting of the board, no further business can be presented unless by 2/3 
majority and a motion is in order to adjourn.

for employment in, or operation and administration of any program or activity in the Manchester School District.  The Title IX Coordinator is Dr. Kelly 
Espinola for staff and students. 
 
Per the Strategic Plan, our Mission objective is to provide a transformational learning experience and ensure that every MSD learner has high 
quality postsecondary options to attain a technical certificate, gainful employment, and/or a two-year or four-year degree.
